prompt: Overnight, a routine deploy shipped to the email/notifications service, and support is now flooded with "This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired" reports. The unsubscribe token is stateless — no DB row backs it — and the discriminating evidence is that links from emails sent BEFORE the deploy all fail, links from emails sent AFTER the deploy work fine, and the failure onset lines up exactly with the deploy time. I'm giving you the `UnsubscribeTokenService` plus a fragment of the deploy's config diff — walk me through the root cause, explain precisely why the verification behaves this way, then tell me how you'd roll out a safe fix and what the blast radius of this incident is.
